from google.cloud.aiplatform.gapic.schema import predict

def embed_audit_notes(project_id: str, location: str, text: str) -> list[float]:
    """Embeds crypto audit notes using Google's Vertex AI Embedding API.

    Args:
        project_id: Your Google Cloud project ID.
        location: The region of the Vertex AI endpoint (e.g., "us-central1").
        text: The text to embed.

    Returns:
        A list of floats representing the embedding vector.
    """
    api_endpoint = f"{location}-aiplatform.googleapis.com"
    client_options = {"api_endpoint": api_endpoint}
    client = aiplatform.gapic.PredictionServiceClient(client_options=client_options)

    # Use the 'text-embedding-004' model for embeddings
    model_id = "text-embedding-004"
    endpoint = client.endpoint_path(
        project=project_id, location=location, endpoint=model_id
    )

    instance = predict.instance.TextEmbeddingPredictionInstance(
        content=text
    ).to_value()
    instances = [instance]

    response = client.predict(endpoint=endpoint, instances=instances)
    
    embeddings = []
    for prediction in response.predictions:
        pb = prediction.pb
        if pb.HasField("struct_value"):
            embeddings.extend(list(pb.struct_value.fields["embeddings"].list_value.values[0].list_value.values))
    
    return [e.number_value for e in embeddings]","filePath":"crypto_audit_embedding.py"},"output":"Wrote file successfully.","metadata":{"diagnostics":{},"filepath":"/private/var/folders/bf/pt_kfhl16yb4r9vfb588n1fm0000gn/T/vb-staged-sctpc4af/crypto_audit_embedding.py","exists":false,"truncated":false},"title":"private/var/folders/bf/pt_kfhl16yb4r9vfb588n1fm0000gn/T/vb-staged-sctpc4af/crypto_audit_embedding.py","time":{"start":1789861751785,"end":1789861751790}},"metadata":{"google":{"thoughtSignature":""}},"id":"prt_0bc12ebe60014vfqB3blbrZ3j4","sessionID":"ses_f43ed2b28ffeMJtxMHpUBEoVPg","messageID":"msg_0bc12d4e30010wb4nEHmxNKDr6"}}
